entities.summary: Olugbenga Agboola is a Nigerian software engineer, entrepreneur, and business leader. He is the CEO and co-founder of Flutterwave, Vice Chairman of the U.S.-Africa Business Center Board, and a member of prominent business organizations including the Milken Institute Africa Business Leaders Council, the Wall Street Journal CEO Council, and the Fast Company Impact Council. He launched Go Time AI, which is designed to support African startups building artificial intelligence products which offers up to $200,000 in funding and mentorship to selected startups.
